name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.6 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-01-22, at wavelengths from 1.01 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
